'''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2023-12-11 — 2025-06-19 |G2 Esports|Coach}} {{TH|2026-01-05 — '''Present''' |BC.Game Esports|Coach}} }} Wiktor "'''TaZ'''" Wojtas {{born}} is a [[:Category:Poland|Polish]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' coach and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' and ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' player. He was part of the very successful Polish [[Golden Five]] lineup in ''[[Counter-Strike]]'', winning [[WCG]] three times, two [[ESWC]] trophies, and the [[IEM|IEM World Championship]] twice. In [[CS:GO]], TaZ was a member of the longest-standing roster in the game's history and managed big wins such as [[ESL/Major_Series_One/2014/Katowice|EMS Katowice 2014]], [[ELEAGUE/Season 1|ELEAGUE S1]], and [[DreamHack/2017/Las Vegas|DH Las Vegas 2017]]. He announced his retirement as a player on March 31st, 2023. {{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/g5taz/status/1641744391952891904|title=I retire see You around|date=2023-03-31|author='''TaZ'''}} ==Achievements== {{Tabs dynamic |name1=As Player |name2=As Coach |This=2 |content1= {{Player achievements table|player=TaZ}} |content2= {{Coach achievements table|coach=TaZ}} }} ==Trivia== ===Personal=== * TaZ became a father on January 9, 2017. {{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/TeamVirtuspro/status/818467857247993856|title=We congratulate TaZ on the arrival of a newborn baby and wish it good health!|date=2017-01-09|author=[[Virtus.pro]]}} ===Awards=== * Was ranked the 6th best player of 2011 by [[HLTV]]. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/8021/top-20-players-of-2011-taz-6|date=2012-01-15|title=Top 20 players of 2011: TaZ (6)|publisher=[[HLTV]]|author=[[Tgwri1s]]}} ===Records=== * '''TaZ''' is one of the few players to win three [[World Cyber Games|WCG]] series. The others being his then-teammates in the original [[Golden Five]]: [[NEO]], [[kuben]], and [[Loord]]. * At 4 years, 5 months and 1 day, '''TaZ''', [[NEO]], [[pashaBiceps]], [[Snax]] and [[byali]] is the longest-lasting lineup in the history of [[CS:GO]]. They played their first game on September 5th, 2013 under [[ESC Gaming]]'s banner and continued to stay together until February 6th, 2018 when '''TaZ''' was benched from [[Virtus.pro]] to make way for [[MICHU]]. * '''TaZ''' and [[NEO]] formed the longest partnership across all versions of Counter-Strike which spans 6138 days in total. Their first period of alliance lasted 5052 days, from April 8th, 2004 when they joined forces in [[Team Pentagram]] to February 6th, 2018 when '''TaZ''' was benched from [[Virtus.pro]]. Later on, the duo played together for 38 more days, starting when [[NEO]] stepped in for [[ARCY]] on December 7th, 2019 until [[ARCY]] officially disbanded on January 14th, 2020. The duo then extended their partnership further when they reunited in [[HONORIS]] on May 18th, 2020.
